author: Elizabeth Madox Roberts
title: Under the Tree
edition: New York: B. W. Huebsch, 1922 (copyright 1922), the first edition. Project Gutenberg eBook #20909, produced by Distributed Proofreaders from page images in the Kentuckiana Digital Library; it reproduces the title page and copyright leaf. The library text holds the author’s epigraph from “On the Hill” with its printed row of asterisks, the dedication, the acknowledgments and all fifty-two poems; the title page, copyright leaf, contents and the transcribers’ closing line are left out. Poem titles are headings; stanza and line breaks follow the transcription; paired underscores mark the edition’s italics. No letter is emended.

rights.basis: Published in New York by B. W. Huebsch in 1922 with a 1922 copyright notice, reproduced in the transcription. A work published in the United States before 1931 is public domain there in 2026; Project Gutenberg records the eBook as public domain in the USA. No modern introduction, annotation or illustration is reproduced.

acquisition.method: Project Gutenberg plain text (CRLF line ends removed) converted by a one-off script: the Project Gutenberg header and licence, title page, copyright leaf, contents and the closing line “The end of Under the Tree” were dropped; each all-capital title line became a heading and every other blank-line-separated group of lines a stanza with its line breaks; the epigraph, dedication lines and acknowledgments are separate blocks. Every poem title in the contents has exactly one heading.
